esp32.detail: 3 pins wired; MQ-8 hydrogen gas sensor module needs at least 4.9 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.AO → D32 (GPIO32) — an analog-capable pin. Added a 10 kΩ / 20 kΩ divider on AO: it swings to 5 V, and the D32 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added the mq8.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the AO voltage set on the slider (through the divider): passes
